title: Quote loop over a generative backdrop (Canvas)
description: A quote or lyric card: a large accent opening mark settles, the quote arrives phrase by phrase in a refined serif (soft-focus fade and rise, paced at reading speed), then an accent rule draws and the attribution and optional source track in. Behind it a slow generative backdrop: a soft mesh gradient with silk flow lines, drifting bokeh dust, or the gradient alone, all periodic in the duration so the clip loops seamlessly. A pool of ground colour keeps the copy legible. Works at any aspect ratio.

quote.default: We read to know we are not alone.
quote.description: The quote or lyric, exactly as approved; surrounding quotation marks are drawn by the scene. Phrases break at punctuation

attribution.description: Who said or wrote it, exactly as approved (empty for none)

source.description: Optional work, album or year under the attribution (empty for none)

backdrop.description: silk: flow-field lines with travelling glints; dust: drifting bokeh motes; mesh: the soft gradient alone

palette.description: Ground, ink (quote), accent (mark, rule, lines) and glow (second backdrop hue); ink is swapped for a readable one if it falls under 4.5:1

typeface.description: Quote face: system serif (EB Garamond, Noto Serif, Georgia...), its italic, or light Inter

tempo.description: Reading pace as phrases arrive (1.0 = about 14 characters per second)

motion.description: How far the backdrop drifts over the loop

scrim.description: Strength of the soft ground-colour pool behind the copy

caps.description: Set the attribution in tracked capitals

loop.description: Dissolve the copy over the last 1.1 s so the last frame matches the first

grain.description: Film grain amount (also prevents gradient banding)

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`.

Serif copy uses the first installed system serif (EB Garamond, Noto Serif Display, Georgia, Liberation Serif...); the attribution uses Inter or the system sans. No font is downloaded, so line breaks can differ between machines with different fonts.

Typesetting: the largest size that fits (searching down to 85% of it for better breaks), with line breaks that balance the measure, prefer breaking after punctuation and avoid ending a line on a short function word. The attribution is set in tracked capitals when it fits, else as written, else on two lines. The page throws if the copy cannot fit.

Beats: opening mark 0.3 s; first phrase at 0.9 s; later phrases at about 14 characters per second times tempo (at least 0.9 s each, slowed by at most 15% to fill a long shot, compressed to at most 20 characters per second); attribution 0.15 s after the last phrase; copy dissolves from D-1.1 s when loop is on. The page throws if the quote cannot be read in the duration (a 140-character quote with a 40-character attribution and 48-character source needs about 14 s).
Backdrop motion is periodic in the duration, so with loop on the last frame matches the first.
